direction: Ways of making room: a bounded apartment balcony, the space old friends open for one another, and water taking a burden onward. Architectural graphite, small-figure gouache and a close ink wash vary human distance, density and medium. Witness and direct social argument remain text-led.

items.title: A small balcony
items.rationale: The poem makes the apartment balcony a centre of ordinary life inside a carefully earned but socially enclosed home. Attend to the drying sari and bounded space, without an aspirational real-estate display or an inventory of every noun.

review.notes: Normal-size review: cloth weight, folds and line contact are plausible; balcony rails meet the parapet and recede coherently. Indigo/rust cotton and pale plaster retain the poem’s small domestic enclosure. Right-side space rests quietly. Flowers are more open than specified but remain a minor ordinary detail consistent with the poem, not an ornamental centerpiece. Painted edges and restrained light pass; no text or invented people.

items.alt: An indigo sari dries on a small apartment balcony beside a flower pot and pale plaster wall.

items.title: Friends found again
items.rationale: After lost youth and unhelpful cliches, a reunion returns the speaker to shared delight. Small anonymous figures give the warmth of meeting without inventing a portrait of the poet or documenting his real academy friends.

review.notes: Normal-size review passes: three fictional older adults have coherent bodies and grounded feet; shoulder contact and greeting are legible, and the third participant naturally leans into the conversation. Figures stay small within a broad sea-side space. Gouache marks vary with plane and shadow; no glossy skin or exaggerated age caricature. Added shade tree and low wall support plausible light without competing with the reunion. This is a literary interpretation, not a record of the author or real friends.

items.alt: Three anonymous older friends greet each other in a shaded courtyard beside the sea.

items.title: Water carrying on
items.rationale: Water accepts dirt while continuing forward without reward. A close material observation of flowing water carrying a fine sediment plume preserves the poem’s movement without a generic mountain panorama or moral-symbol collage.

review.notes: Normal-size review passes: thin current divides around the partly submerged stone and carries an ochre sediment plume onward. Waterline, directional reflections and changing opacity support physical flow. Left-side mineral detail resolves into quiet pale space, preserving movement without a landscape cliché. Soft watercolor edges and selective ink remain visible; no added symbols, lettering or mechanical texture.

items.alt: Shallow water flows around a grey stone, carrying a soft ochre trail of sediment.

text_led.rationale: Let the author’s witness to the Pahalgam attack stand in words; do not invent victims, identities or a documentary scene.
The final arrival of spring is the poem’s revelation. A text-led opening lets the hospitality and transformation unfold without showing the ending in advance.
Preserve the urgent argument for an environment where a girl can grow safely, without a sentimental child illustration or surveillance imagery.
